rationale: Jacob and Caleb are both SF-based founders building in robotics and AI, with complementary technical strengths that could accelerate each other's work. Jacob brings deep full-stack AI systems expertise (evolutionary algorithms, agent infrastructure, on-device AI) from his background at AGI, Inc., while Caleb is building Ark Robotics with hands-on full-stack software engineering across MERN and robotics projects. Jacob's conviction around physical intelligence and perception systems paired with Caleb's robotics focus and web stack could unlock value as both scale their respective companies.
intro_message: Jacob Valdez, meet Caleb Martin — you're both founders in robotics and AI based in SF, and your full-stack AI infrastructure expertise (Jacob) plus robotics-focused engineering (Caleb) could be a natural fit to explore.
